Hildegard 0.1.14 is a pre-alpha. It fixes connecting from claude.ai.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? Hildegard updates itself, or run `hildegard update` (or `hildegard update all` for every device).

## Fixed

- Adding Hildegard as a custom connector in claude.ai no longer stops at "Can't connect … Invalid IP address:
  undefined". Hildegard reads the app's published details through a guard that allows only public addresses, and on
  Node 20 and later that guard answered Node's request for every address with a single one.
